definition: Sulphur, especially when imagined as burning or producing fumes.
author: Homer
quote: Then Jove let fly with his thunderbolts and the ship went round and round and was filled with fire and brimstone as the lightning struck it.
example_sentence: The preacher promised fire and brimstone.
